Mahmudul Islam, Senior Advocate, instructed by Md. Abu Siddique, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Respondents
parties:
Md. Ismail Hossain Sarker and others ------ Appellants
Vs.
Khushi Mohan Mondal and Ors. ------ Respondents
full_judgment: "The appellate Court as well as the High Court Division has failed to arrive at a decision to the effect that the plaintiff failed to prove his case in the light of the decisions reported in 24 DLR 274 and 39 DLR (AD) 237. The High Court Division and the Court of appeal have failed to avert to the findings and observation as manifested in the judgment of the trial Court passed in Other Suit No. 251 of 1994 dismissing the suit and as such the impugned judgments are not proper judgments of reversal in the background of the decisions reported in 1997 BLT (AD) 15 and 37 DLR 93 placing reliance on the decisions reported in 1960 (SC) 115, AIR 1951 (SC) 120 and also 34 DLR (AD) 52."
